long_description:
Automate internal auditing (planning, testing, documenting) to comply better with financial regulations.

Denki performs audit work with 99% software, 1% services:

✔️ Works on existing systems (e.g. Auditboard, Workiva, ERPs)
✔️ Automates Control processes (e.g. collects evidence, runs walkthrough interviews, tests)
✔️ Records every step for traceability (workpapers w/ full audit trace)

Focused on SOX programs and financial regulations (SEC Rules etc.)

launches.body:
### Strengthen your Internal Audit programs (from SOX to BSA/AML)

**Denki Assurance Platform:**

✔️ Works on existing systems (e.g. Auditboard, Workiva, ERPs)

✔️ Automates Control processes (e.g. maps to COSO, runs walkthrough interviews, tests)

✔️ Produces working papers (w/ full audit traces)

Request demo here: https://denki.ai/demo

🙏 **Our ask:**

If you **know any internal auditor** or **CFO**

➡️ Send an intro to [founders@denki.ai](https://mailto:founders@denki.ai) –– thank you!

**The Problem**

Audit is a massive cost centre ($290B+ annual spend), mandated by regulation (SOX, BSA/AML), facing talent shortages (75% of CPA will retire in the next decade) and a source of significant operational friction.

It runs the trust system of our economy, yet it’s truly outdated: sampling-based, point-in-time, manual.\
\
**The Solution**\
\
[Demo](https://youtu.be/-vFX_Cfcyxo)

**The Team**

**Felipe** worked at McKinsey and researched on Explainable AI during his PhD studies at UCL. He led product + mobile engineering at a GE-funded start-up.

**David** built pipelines for unstructured financial data at MacroHive (research firm trusted by all top 5 hedge funds). He is a top 13 competitive programmer in the UK Informatics Olympiad, and studied Computing at Imperial.

➡️ Request demo here: https://denki.ai/demo

📩 **Questions?** Email us at: [founders@denki.ai](https://mailto:founders@denki.ai)

🙏 **Our ask:** Make an intro for us with **an internal auditor** or **CFO** – thank you!
